title: Visual review verdicts (version 1.0.0)
description: The owner's verdict per diagram element, kept in .discovery/visual-review/<ID>/review.json of the run's repo root (VR-04). One line per (diagram, element): a new verdict on the same element replaces the old line. A line whose anchor.graph_hash differs from the hash of the diagram file as it is now is outdated (made on an older graph) and is not counted as checked; a line whose element is no longer a node of the diagram is gone (kept, shown as 'element gone'). graph_hash is the sha256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the diagram file: keys sorted at every depth, every $-prefixed key dropped (shared/questions/vrlayout.ts graphHash). An element is a node of l0, l1 or l2.json.

element.description: The node id, the stable id of graph.schema.json.

verdict.description: remove = remove from scope. An element with no line is 'not yet looked at'.
